This project is a React single-page application that visualizes company-brand relationships as a graph using data from Wikidata/Wikipedia, including company logos from Wikimedia Commons. Prioritize SPARQL queries to Wikidata for relationships and logo image (P154) properties. Use vis-network for graph rendering.
